name: Show Director
description: Adds a director line to library cards in Jellyfin Web (Title / Director / Year), reading directly from each item's own Jellyfin metadata - no external lookups. Configurable from the admin dashboard: separator for multiple directors, how many to show before truncating, and which item types (movies, series, episodes) it applies to.
overview: Shows the director's name on movie and series cards in Jellyfin Web.

versions.changelog:
- Center the inserted director name line on cards. - Packaged for install via a Jellyfin plugin repository - no more manual
  DLL copying required.
